control: v044, FP32 highest/allow_tf32=false, replay-safe static-KV stack
treatment: same v044 weights, TF32 high/allow_tf32=true, same replay-safe static-KV stack selected by the formal NUMERIC package
seed_rule: seed = 1000 + 50 * task_id + episode_index; all 500 seeds are unique, and each pair uses the identical seed and initial state in both arms
policy_rng_rule: batch size 1; torch is explicitly reseeded to 1000 + 50 * task_id + episode_index at every policy.reset, independently of preceding trajectory length
simulator_rule: init_states=true, hard_reset=true, init_state_id=episode_index, synchronous single environment, 256x256 observations
arm_order: even task id: control then treatment; odd task id: treatment then control
primary_estimand: treatment task success rate minus control task success rate over paired episodes

statistical_method.name: Tango matched-pair score confidence bound for the paired binary risk difference
statistical_method.mcnemar_role: two-sided exact McNemar p-value is descriptive for equality only and never decides non-inferiority
statistical_method.power_assumption: at true difference 0 and 500 pairs, approximately 80% power requires a discordance rate no greater than about 0.20

decision_rule: the Tango paired one-sided 95% lower confidence bound for treatment minus control must exceed -0.05; this is a nominal one-sided alpha=0.05 score procedure, not a finite-sample exact test

task_collapse.definition: for any preregistered task, control has at least one success and treatment has zero successes
task_collapse.decision: FAIL regardless of the aggregate primary non-inferiority result

input_format: JSONL, exactly 500 rows per arm with run_id, arm, suite, task_id, task, episode_index, episode_id, seed, init_state_id, policy_seed, checkpoint_revision and boolean success
identity_rule: paired_run_manifest.json locks the checkpoint revision, preregistration hash, source hashes, and control/treatment hashes before the first outcome; the certifier takes identities only from that immutable manifest
null_controls: before any paired outcome is written, run task 0 episode 0 twice in fresh FP32 processes and require identical success and action-trace hash
before any paired outcome is written, run task 0 episode 0 twice in fresh TF32 processes and require identical success and action-trace hash
